notes.title: 《the Chronicles of Dragon Wing》2024 Summer Update
notes.content:
[b]The new version is 1.4.0 after the update[/b]

[h1]New 4th Skill unlock for the following characters![/h1]
[list]
[*] The Volt
[*] The Revived
[*] Black Succuba
[*] Card Master
[*] Alchemist
[*] Ascetic
[*] Phantom Edge
[*] Wolf Blade
[*] Valkyrie
[*] Nature Spirit
[/list]

[h1]Balance Change[/h1]
[list]
[*] Explode Shot (Wind Runner): Range decreases to 1-4 from 1-5
[*] Space Transfer (The Revived): Range decreases to 1-3 from 1-4
[*] Final Shot (Card Master): Range increases to 1-3 from 1-2
[*] Laser Beam (Temple Guardian): Range increases to 1-4 from 1-3
[*] Bullet Barrier (Eagle Eye): Range decreases to 1-3 from 1-5
[*] Preparation (Shadow Killer): Required cards increase to 3 from 2
[*] Avulsion (Bloody Claws): Cause 1 Bleeding instead of 2, added “Cause 1 more Bleeding to target with less HP”
[*] Soul Attack (Covenanter): Now ignore Dodge
[*] Phantom Edge: HP increases to 8 from 7
[*] Adventurer: HP increases to 8 from 7
[*] Flint (Thunder Spirit): Condition to decrease cooldown change to “move distance less equal to 3
[*] Dark Chaser: HP increases to 8 from 7
[*] Draw Art (Dark Chaser): Remove Slow Attack, used card or skill increases to 6 from 5 to trigger Silence Attack
[*] God of Death (The Death): Recover HP decreases to 1 from 2
[*] Holy Sacrifice (Guardian Angel): Range decreases to 0-3 from 0-5
[*] Folk Lottery: Price increases to 4 from 3, success rate decrease to 30% from 35%, gain gold increases to 8 from 3
[*] Void Staff: Price decreases to 12 from 13
[*] Yang’s Staff: Price decreases to 10 from 11
[*] Sprint Boots: Price decreases to 10 from 12
[/list]

[h1]Character Rework[/h1]
[b]We modified all 4 skills for Fire Waver[/b]
[olist]
[*] Burst Flame: Range decreases to 1-3 from 1-4, Damage increases to 3 from 2, Remove Seal
[*] Flame Dragon: Range increases to 1-4 from 1-3 (Straight), Damage decreases to 2 from 2/2/3
[*] Dragon Slayer: Range increases to 1-4 from 1-3
[*] Fervor Dance: Effect changes to remove all Slowdown and gain Sprint
[/olist]

[h1]Other Change[/h1]
[list]
[*] Improve text
[/list]

notes.title: 《the Chronicles of Dragon Wing》major updates!
notes.content:
[h1]New Character has Arrived! Are you ready for hunting?[/h1]
[b]Demon Hunter - Dianna
Type: dex, HP: 7, Speed: 3[/b]
[list]
[*]Ambusher
Skill • Extra • Passive
Cooldown: -
Distance: -
If you didn’t move in the movement phase, get [Ambush] buff.
※Extra skill will auto activated
※[Ambush] buff: Normal attack cause additional [Bleeding] and [Slowdown], until your turn ends, or after you use normal attack or hero skill.

[*]Sniper Bowgun
Skill • Passive
Cooldown: -
Distance: -
Normal attack range +3
Normal attack can not target adjacent enemy
Normal attack cause additional [Bleeding]

[*]Power Shot
Skill • Active
Cooldown: 2
Distance: 2-4
Target an enemy, cause 2 magic damage and [Slowdown]. If you have [Ambush], cause 1 more magic damage.

[*]Hiding Action
Skill • Active
Cooldown: 2
Distance: -
Use directly, get [Ambush] buff, recover 1 HP and get 1 [Leap]. If you already have [Ambush], draw 1 card.[/list]

[h1]5 more characters had unlocked their 4th skill![/h1]
[list]
[*] Natural Balance (Phantom Spear)
Skill • Active
Cooldown: 2
Distance: 1-3
Target a character, remove target’s [status]. If the target is enemy, cause 2 magic damage, otherwise recover 2 HP and get [Asylum].

[*] Barrage（Hawkeye）
Skill • Active
Cooldown: 2
Distance: 1-5
Target a grid. Cause 1 magic damage and [slowdown] to each enemy who on the target grid or adjacent to it. Cause 1 more magic damage and [slowdown] to a random enemy within range.

[*] Provoke（Battlefield Tiger）
Skill • Passive
Cooldown: -
Distance: -
When your turn start, has 50% chance get 1 [Taunt].
When you lose HP by taking physic/magic damage, has 50% chance get 1 [Taunt].
When you use [Taunt], recover your HP by 1.

[*] Rock Cage（Ancient Rock）
Skill • Active
Cooldown: 2
Distance: 1-3
Target an enemy, cause 1 magic damage to the target. All accessible grid become [Rock] until your next turn starts.
※[Evolve] buff: cause 1 more magic damage

[*] Excalibur（Guardian Angel） 
Skill • Active
Cooldown: 3
Distance: 1-3
Target an enemy, remove all characters’ [Status], then cause 2+X magic damage to the target. X equals the number of characters who had [Status] removed, with the maximum of 3.[/list]

[h1]New Gear available! [/h1]
[list][*]Asylum Armor
Armor • Passive
Price: 17 G
Cooldown: -
Distance: -
When you loss 2 or more HP by taking physic/magic damage, get [Asylum]

[*]Wind Edge
Weapon • Passive
Price: 10 G
Cooldown: -
Distance: -
When normal attack hits, get 1 [Tailwind].

[*]Heavy Bowgun
Weapon • Active
Price: 14 G
Cooldown: 3
Distance: -
Cause 1 damage to the enemy base.[/list]

[h1]Balance change[/h1]
[olist]
[*] Fightress: HP 8 → 9, type Dex → Str
[*] Knee Strike (Fightress): cause magic damage → cause physic damage
[*] Burst Flame (Flame Waver): distance 1-3 → 1-4
[*] Flint (Thunder Panda): cause damage to the 1st enemy on the path → cause damage to all enemies on the path
[*] Bloody Slash (Wolf Blade): cause 4-X magic damage → cause 5-X magic damage
[*] Final Shot (Card Master): distance 1-3 → 1-2, damage 2 → 1
[/olist]

[h1]Gear price change[/h1]
[olist]
[*] Elf’s Dagger 15→14
[*] Paladin’s Hammer16→14
[/olist]

[h1]Others[/h1]
[olist]
[*] Card [the Great Seal] distance change from Max to 1-4
[*] New avatar [Demon Hunter], [Pioneer], [Advanturer], [Guardian], [Follower]
[*] New skin for Phantom Spear: the Dragon Spear
[*] Fix the error when buying skill in destiny mode
[*] Fix the number of Soul Lantern in death match map when playing destiny mode
[*] Fix the friend list issue when a friend is in destiny mode
[*] Text improvement
[*] Minor bug fixed
[/olist]

[i]The server will have an update maintain at 13:00 pm, 28th, Sep. 2019. 
The new version is 1.3.5 after the update.[/i]

notes.title: 《the Chronicles of Dragon Wing》Lunar New Year Update! Unlock the 4th Skill!
notes.content:
The server will have an update maintain at 22:00pm, 29th, Jan. 2019. Estimate maintain time is 2 hours.
The new version is 1.3.0 after the update.

[h1]New 4th Skill unlock for FREE! There are 10 characters have their new skills. (Others will be unlock in later update)[/h1]

[olist][*]Freezing Storm (Crystal Fortune)
Skill · Active
Cooldown：3
Range：1-5
Cause 2 magic damage and 2 [Slowdown] to each enemy within range.

[*]Fervor Dance (Flame Waver)
Skill · Active
Cooldown：1
Distance：-
Target a grid that you can move to.
Move to target position and get Buff: Normal attack range +1 in this turn.

[*]Explode Shot (Wind Runner)
Skill · Active
Cooldown：1
Distance：1-5
Target a grid.
Cause [Bleeding] to each enemy on the target grid or adjacent grid. Push back all character(s) adjacent to target for 1 grid.

[*]Healing Guard(Soul Healer)
Skill · Active
Cooldown：1
Distance：1-5
Target an accessible grid.
Set a [Healing Guard] on target grid, which will be removed when your next turn start. When an ally’s turn ends, if the distance between [Healing Guard] ≤ 2, that ally recovers HP by 1.

[*]Palming (Gambler)
Skill · Passive(Aura)
Cooldown：-
Range：Infinite
Ally character’s unstable card will not be automatic discard.
When your normal attack hits enemy, cause 1 more magic damage if you have more cards than target.

[*]Preparation (Shadow Killer)
Skill · Passive
Cooldown：-
Distance：-
You can use cast 1 more normal attack if you use 2 or more cards in one turn.

[*]Punishment (Assassinator)
Skill · Passive
Cooldown：-
Distance：-
When normal attack hit enemy with HP ≤ 5, cause 1 more physic damage and randomly decrease 1 of your active skill’s cooldown by 1.

[*]God of Death (The Death)
Skill · Passive
Cooldown：-
Distance：-
Max HP +1.
After other character died, you get buff: Max HP+1, then recover your HP by 2 and draw 1 card.
Teammate can revive at accessible grid adjacent to you.

[*]Buried Flower (Phantom Dancer)
Skill · Active
Cooldown：2
Distance：1-2
Target an enemy.
Select an accessible grid adjacent to you, move to selected grid and cause X magic damage to the target, X equals to your current speed – target’s, with maximum of 3.

[*]Knee Strike (Fightress)
Skill · Active
Cooldown：2
Distance：1-1
Target an enemy.
Cause 2 magic damage to the target and [Destroy] all target’s equipment.[/olist]

[h1]Balance Change[/h1]
[olist][*]Crystal Javelin: Price decrease to 4 from 5
[*]Leather Armor: Price decrease to 6 from 7
[*]Trick Hood: Price decrease to 10 from 12
[*]Anti-magic Robe: Price decrease to 12 from 13
[*]Silver Fantasy: Price decrease to 14 from 15[/olist]

[h1]Other Change[/h1]
[olist][*]FRogN’s Staff can be unlock and set in backpack now.
[*]New Skin: Flare Demon for Fire Waver now available.
[*]New Lunar New Year decoration.
[*]Improve text.
[*]Minor bug fixed.[/olist]

Happy Lunar New Year!

notes.title: 1st anniversary of the Chronicles of Dragon Wing! New story, new maps and new character!
notes.content:
The server will have an update maintain at 21:00pm, 15th, Aug. 2018. Estimate maintain time is 6 hours.
The new version is 1.2.0 after the update.

[h1]Game updates[/h1]
[olist][*]New stories! Episode 4 and 5 is now available for free!
[*]New game mode: Death Match! 3 death match maps are available for free after player level reach 20 and complete story episode 5-2.
[*]New map! The brand-new map Ice Throat for Siege mode is available for free after player level reach 20.[/olist]

[h1]New Epic Character[/h1]
[b]Miracle magician – Yang
Type: INT, Speed: 3, HP: 8[/b]
[list][*]Anti-Gravity
Active, Cooldown: 2, Range: 1-5
Target an ally
Choose one effect:
-Select an area adjacent to the target, you teleport to that area
-Select an area adjacent to you, target teleports to that area

[*]Misguide
Active, Cooldown: 2, Range: 1-2
Target an enemy
Select an area adjacent to you, teleport the target to that area 
-If the distance between you and target is 1, deal 2 magic damage to the target, otherwise deal 2 magic damage

Passive, Aura, Range: Infinite
When a character’s position changes not in his turn:
-if is an enemy, deal 1 [bleeding]
-if is an ally, heal 1 HP[/list]

[h1]Balance adjustment[/h1]
[list][*][Ancient Blade]
Increase Raikiri’s range to 1-2

[*][Explorer]
Windfall now have 100% to get 1 extra gold, but have no chance to get 1 card or 2 gold

[*][God of War·Glory]
Price decrease to 9 from 10[/list]

[h1]Other adjustment[/h1]
[olist][*]Fix the problem when player get an extra turn when suicide by using Time-Space Emblem
[*]Fix the problem that player has a chance to activate an extra skill
[*]Fix the leaderboard problem
[*]Fix the problem that player is offline when playing Fate Gambling
[*]Fix the perusing problem of Trick hood
[*]Improve text[/olist]

notes.title: Big update is here! New mode! New characters!
notes.content:
[b]The server will maintain at 23:30（UTC+8）. Estimated time is 2 hour.
The new version is 1.1.0[/b]

[h1]New Mode: the Fate Gambling[/h1]
Win or Lose? What is the fate waiting for you?
[list][*]This mode only support 1v1. Player can bet before matching, and paid according to the result: the winner gets double, the loser lose everything.
[*]This mode is available from 19:00 to 23:00(UTC+8). A hint will show up when available.
[*]Wager have a limit for every day and every match. When you reach the limit, you can still play this mode without wager. Wager limit will reset every morning.
[*]Both player will have 18 available characters from their own characters.
[*]Both player ban 2 characters from their opponent’s character pool. Then pick up 3 characters in order.
[*]Your opponent’s ID will not show during the ban-pick.
[*]You can check how much you and your opponent bet during the battle
[*]You can see how much you get or lose in the result screen
[*]Quest, winning streak and win rate is available in this mode.
[*]Two leaderboards for this mode is added.
[/list]

[h1]New Characters DLC: the Surge of Undercurrent[/h1]
[url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/675430/The_Chronicles_of_Dragon_Wing__The_Surge_of_Undercurrent/]Buy Now [/url]
9 brand new characters
Including 2 epic characters and 3 characters with extra skill. Extra skill will make the skill combination more interesting! 
Buy now and get 1 more bag and 10000 crystal
[b]Character list[/b]
[list][*]Ursa
[*]Covenanter
[*]The Death
[*]Arsonist
[*]Thunder Spirit (epic)
[*]Monkey King (epic)
[*]Beggar Master (extra skill)
[*]Ancient Blade (extra skill)
[*]Weapon Master (extra skill)[/list]

[h1]Balance adjustment[/h1]
[b]Character skill (adjustment of skills from the new DLC is based on the test server)[/b]
[olist][*]Dark Chaser
[Draw Art]
The effect of [far attack] is changed to [slow attack] (attack cause [slow] when hit)
[Triple Slash]
[slash] is now a normal card

[*]Arsonist
[Incineration]
The effect of[Multiply] is changed to:
-15% cause [slow]
-15% cause [root]
-15% cause [seal]
-15% cause [bleeding]
-15% cause [silence]
-15% cause [stun]

[*]Elven Light
[Wind’s guide]
Max distance decreased to 4 from 5

[*]Ursa
[Frenzy]
Frenzy now can get 1 [rage]

[*]The Death
[Death Scythe]
If you target a character and a barrier is between you and your target, the scythe will have 30% chance miss[/olist]

[b]Equipment adjustment[/b]
[olist][*]Bravely Shield
The price decrease to 8 from 10

[*]Bloody Blade
This weapon is completely changed
The price is still 16G.
When you attack an enemy with 5 or less HP, cause 1 additional physic damage

[*]Elegant Boots
This accessory is completely changed
The price is decreased to 7 from 9
[slow] can NOT decrease your movement to 1 or less [/olist]

[h1]Other adjustment[/h1]
[olist][*]Enhanced the buff of guild
[*]Increase the preparation time of the co-op PVE
[*]Alchemist and other 9 new characters’ avatar is available now
[*][Philosopher’s stone] can now derive all cards
[*]Battle shop will now sell items from all equipment
[*]Fix some display bugs
[*]Improve some text[/olist]

notes.title: Co-op mode is available now!
notes.content:
The most-anticipated co-op mode is coming, and support both solo match and team-up match.
Please try to match when there are lots of player on the server,otherwise, you may need to wait for a long time.
Additionally, you will prior match players who are teamed-up when you are teamed-up.

[h1]Skill adjustment[/h1]
[olist]
[*][Phantom Assassin]
Fixed the text error of Inky interference, the God of War·Glory will not have effect on this skill.
[*][Sharkkwi]
The effect of Anchor of Siren was changed as below:
Your attack range +1, when you attack at [water], cause 1 physic damage additionally
Friendly unit can attack at [water] and cause [slowdown] additionally.
[*][Ninja]
Amaterasu now can cause 2 magic damage and [seal] to adjacent enemies.[/olist]

[h1]Equipment adjustment[/h1]
